The vendor directly providing **Atua** at **atua.app** is **DevLab Systems LLC**.

### Supporting Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Service** on `atua.app`:
> *"These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of Atua (“the App”), a macOS application developed and operated by DevLab Systems LLC (“we”, “us”, or “our”)."*

The Terms of Service further state under Intellectual Property:
> *"Atua, including its design, code, and branding, is the intellectual property of DevLab Systems LLC."*
